I wanted to start a different kind of car company built on Christian ethics and morals. Our faith guides us, but I tell people all of the time that we love Jesus and set out to honor Him, but that doesn't mean your car will last forever! Lol! What it means is that we are always going to be honest and transparent with you. I am a Veteran and a patriot and believe in old fashioned business practices. I wanted to set out to provide a high quality, used car without all of the dealer tricks and deception. What I found is that other people wanted that too! By being honest and transparent we built our small business into the largest independent dealership in the state. In late 2018 my wife and I sold our business in Indiana and moved to Florida with the dreams of doing the same model here while being closer to our family. We did it with the Lord’s wisdom and help! Our company is called Trade Guru because we specialize in new car trade-ins. If you don't know the difference between a new car trade-in and a normal car at the auction, it is a very important distinction. We look for cars that people trade in just because they want a new one not because there's something wrong with it. We don't buy from independent dealers who are trying to hide their sins and pawn their broken cars off onto other people. Florida is full of nice, low mileage, one owner cars and that's what we specialize in. We mostly buy from local, high-line, luxury car dealerships. These are the cars that people paid 40k to 90k for and have been taken care. That's what we want to give you as the second owner! We look for one to two owner vehicles with documented service histories and CarFax's. We allow you to take our cars to a mechanic to help you make a wise decision for you and your family. We price our cars using Kelly blue book and J.D. Power. If you look at CarGuru’s website, all of our cars are beyond fair deals, as they call them! We have our own experienced technicians, interior upholstery workers, body workers, as well as tire and brake workers to help service your car’s needs. You name it and we can do it all. One of the best values I can offer my customers is a drastically discounted labor rate for the life of the car. That means that when you buy a car from me, if anything were to happen, whether it be brakes or even a motor, you will pay a fraction of the labor cost of any shop in town. In addition to this savings, we will not markup the price on any of the parts your car needs, market price only! That could save you thousands of dollars during the life of your car. Our service department is not a for-profit service department, it is to serve our customers and maintain our cars to keep you coming back and buying from us in the future. We go through our cars and make sure we're selling a good product, but at the end of the day these are machines and sometimes unforeseen things happen. You have my word that I will personally answer your call, work to be at peace with you and find a solution to keep you on the road! Most dealers just say, “Hey, you bought the car as is. Have a great day.” That's not who I am! We are easy to deal with and family owned and operated. You will feel comfortable and at ease the minute you walk in the door, I guarantee! You will NEVER be lied to, I guarantee! You will NEVER be overcharged, I guarantee that also! Please give us a chance to prove that we are a great resource for high-quality, cash cars! the 2015 Town & Country minivan that builds on the base LX model with a mix of added comfort, convenience, style, and technology features — making it a practical and well-equipped family vehicle.
Overview
- Engine & Performance:
- Powered by the standard 3.6 L Pentastar V6 engine producing 283 hp and 260 lb-ft of torque, paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive. EPA-estimated fuel economy is ~17 mpg city/25 mpg highway.

Comfort & Convenience
The Touring trim enhances the already well-appointed base setup with:
- 8-way power-adjustable driver’s seat — more comfort and adjustability for daily driving.
- Automatic headlights and fog lamps — improved lighting convenience and safety.
- Electronic Vehicle Information Center (EVIC) to monitor trip and vehicle data.
- Chrome bodyside molding — subtle exterior styling upgrade.

Interior & Tech
- Leather-trimmed first- and second-row seating, Stow ’n Go seating system, power sliding doors and liftgate, and tri-zone climate control are carried over from LX.
- Entertainment features are available, including a single DVD player and overhead 9-inch screen (enhancing rear-seat comfort.
- A Uconnect infotainment system with touchscreen and smartphone integration is optional if not already equipped on specific vehicles.

Safety & Options
Like all Town & Country trims, the Touring offers a suite of standard safety features such as multiple airbags and a rearview camera, with optional packages (including Safety Tec) that can add blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-path detection, rain-sensing wipers, and more on higher trims.
Summary
The 2015 Town & Country Touring balances functionality and comfort by adding convenience upgrades, enhanced lighting, power seating, and stylish touches to the base minivan formula — making it a strong choice for families who want quality features without stepping up to the more luxurious Touring-L and Limited trims.

description:
Theres a particular kind of authority the 2023 MercedesBenz SClass S 580 wears not the shout of flash, but the slow, sure gravity of something made to be noticed with taste. It approaches like a quiet herald: long, composed lines that read as intent, a silhouette that sits low and broad, and surfaces that catch light like carefully folded fabric. From the curb it doesnt beg for attention, it quietly rearranges the scene so that everything else seems to exist in relation to it. This is presence as punctuation: elegant, unapologetic and utterly assured.

Open the door and the theater becomes immediate. The cabin is more salon than cockpit, a study in hospitality where every surface has been negotiated for comfort and ceremony. Plush materials wrap the space in a tactile hush leather that invites touch, woods and metals that settle the eye, and stitchwork that reads like punctuation in an intimate conversation. Seats cradle with a human kindness, they tilt and pulse like thoughtful hosts, promising solitude or social ease in equal measure. Lighting moves like a stage director, warm and flattering one moment, crisp and utilitarian the next, while sound becomes curated as if the car itself has taste.

On the move the SClass performs the sort of automotive sleight of hand that turns transit into ritual. It glides with an almost leisurely competence: road imperfections transformed into hushed background texture, steering that suggests rather than insists, and a chassis that carries weight with balletic composure. When the mood shifts toward motion, the car responds with measured authority a deliberate, confident forwardness that never needs to shout. Its the kind of machine that makes long distances feel short and short runs feel restful.

The sensory experience is a layered one. Silence is used as an instrument: conversation and music bloom in a cabin that muffles the world with purposeful care. The soundtrack, when allowed, is cultured and persuasive rather than raw. Tech and creature comforts present themselves as discreet aides helpful, omnipresent, but never the star of the show allowing the cars mood to remain human and humane.

Practicality is woven into the luxury: room for living, storage that behaves, and an overall sense that the vehicle is not merely transportation but an extension of a deliberate life. description:
This stunning **2015 Mercedes-Benz E400 Coupe** turns heads with its sleek, elegant silhouette finished in captivating **Tenorite Grey Metallic**, a sophisticated shade that shifts subtly in the light, exuding timeless refinement and modern edge. Inside, the luxurious **grey leather** upholstery wraps you in premium comfort, complemented by the rich warmth of **black ash wood trim** and a striking **black headliner** that creates an intimate, sporty cockpit atmosphere.
Engineered for exhilarating performance, this coupe boasts the potent twin-turbo V6 delivering smooth, responsive power, enhanced by the dynamic **Sport Package** with its aggressive **Sportline** styling cues and commanding **18-inch 5-spoke alloy wheels** rolling on all-season tires. The **multi-contour front seats** mold perfectly to your body for exceptional support during spirited drives, while **heated and ventilated front seats** ensure year-round indulgence, no matter the weather.
Step up to advanced convenience and safety with the comprehensive **Premium Package**, featuring the crystal-clear **Burmester Surround Sound System** that fills the cabin with immersive audio, **SiriusXM Radio** for endless entertainment, and intuitive **COMAND navigation with voice control**. Enjoy effortless entry via **KEYLESS-GO**, power-folding mirrors that tuck neatly, and a **power rear-window sunshade** that glides into place for added privacy and comfort. The **Mirror Package** adds even more sophistication with auto-dimming functionality.
Stay confidently aware on every journey thanks to the **Lane Tracking Package**, including **Blind Spot Assist** to watch your flanks and **Lane Keeping Assist** to gently guide you back if needed, all paired with a **rearview camera** for seamless maneuvering. Grip the beautifully crafted **wood and leather steering wheel** for a tactile connection to the road, and appreciate thoughtful touches like the **rear deck spoiler** that adds a subtle aerodynamic flair, **wheel locks** for peace of mind, and the **media interface cable** ready for your devices.
This E400 Coupe blends grand-touring grace with thrilling dynamics, premium technology, and opulent details into an irresistible package that's pure Mercedes-Benz exhilaration.

This Mythos Black Metallic 2022 Audi A4 Sedan Premium with 18,818 miles has the style and comfort to fit your lifestyle! One Owner! This vehicle is equipped with: Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Audi smartphone interface (Apple CarPlay/Android Auto) smart device wireless mirroring
